Native image contains the exact title and description, an OS-supplied application icon, blue default Try Again, and secondary OK.
Native window is 260×218 points (520×436 pixels). The host OS lays out OK left and Try Again right, versus vertical Try Again/OK in the 260×246-point Figma alert.
Native material is darker than the reference over this host background; no tint, appearance, icon, geometry or custom glass override was introduced.
